generator_cmd: cp march_mips_be.bin march_decoy_badcrc.bin; printf '\xde\xad\xbe\xef' | dd of=march_decoy_badcrc.bin bs=1 seek=228 conv=notrunc   # BE header crc field clobbered
oracle_cmd: bash march_oracle.sh march_decoy_badcrc.bin   # GNU readelf -h/-SW, llvm-objcopy-18 --only-section=.hcfg, perl unpack (header in ELF byte order) + xor, gzip trailer crc32
note: machine label = readelf spelling except EM_386 -> 'x86' (lib.knowledge vocabulary); expected_machine_num = decimal e_machine for kind:integer
